about: Every photograph and hero clip the site shows, with its source. apps/web/src/media/library.json is generated from this file: `pnpm media:remote` points it at the addresses below, `pnpm media:fetch` downloads the files and points it at the copies. To swap a picture, change its image and page here and run one of those commands.
